# ForgingStack Ration

> One quota pool, many agents, no overruns.

Live API: https://forgingstack-ration.jkbattles.workers.dev
Site: https://forgingstack.com/work/ration/
Public repo: https://github.com/jdkabattles/forgingstack-ration
PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/forgingstack-ration/
MCP Registry: io.github.jdkabattles/forgingstack-ration (0.1.0, active)

## What it is

A token-bucket quota pool shared by many agents. A principal creates a pool
(capacity, refill per minute, per-agent cap, burst limit); agents draw units;
the pool enforces the limits and issues a hash-chained receipt for every draw,
allowed or denied.

## API

- POST /v1/signup {email} -> API key once + 100 starter credits (email verification required)
- POST /v1/pools {name, capacity_units, refill_units_per_minute, per_agent_cap_units, burst_units} -> 1 credit
- GET /v1/pools, GET /v1/pools/{id}, DELETE /v1/pools/{id}
- POST /v1/pools/{id}/draw {agent_id, units} -> 1 credit, allowed or denied + receipt
- POST /v1/pools/{id}/topup {units} -> free, clamped at capacity
- GET /v1/credits, GET /v1/receipts/{id}
- POST /v1/billing/checkout -> Stripe Payment Link, $10 for 1,000 credits

Auth: X-API-Key header. Idempotency-Key header on draw; replays are free.
Per-agent cap window: rolling 60 minutes.

## MCP client (this repo)

- python -m app.mcp_server (stdio, stdlib only)
- Tools: create_pool, draw, get_pool, list_pools, topup_pool, delete_pool, get_credits, get_receipt
- Install: pip install forgingstack-ration (entry point: forgingstack-ration)
- Env: FORGINGSTACK_API_KEY (required), FORGINGSTACK_API_BASE (live default)
